name: showtime
description: A local video studio for your coding agent. Describe a video in one sentence: your agent directs, your machine renders. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and more. No API keys, no uploads.

paragraphs: The 0.4.1 showreel: 55 seconds, rendered by showtime 0.4.1 in 2 min 23 s on a 64-core CPU with no GPU; seven real showtime films, then the features behind them (about the film). Download the showreel (full quality, 107 MB). Music: “Supernova” by Scott Buckley, CC BY 4.0. Footage: NASA (public domain); photo: “Godafoss 3” by Tord Dellsen, CC0 (credits).

Voice-over Kokoro, Piper and Supertonic voices, English, Spanish and 30+ more languages, with exact word timings for captions and kinetic type. Music and sound 297 produced tracks (Scott Buckley, Kevin MacLeod, a dozen more composers, public-domain recordings) with the credit written for you, a composer that hits exact lengths, 56 synthesized effect types, 1,334 permissively licensed sounds, beat grids, ducking, mastering. Captions Five styles, burned in or as SRT/VTT, placed inside each platform's safe zone; karaoke from the voice's word times. Footage editing Word-level local transcripts…

Also: 30 motion components (seven of them WebGL looks), 26 transitions (15 CSS, 11 WebGL) and 6 themes, 12 look signatures that new dom, launch, short and data projects start in (a palette, a type pair and a motion feel, picked away from your recent videos; showtime signature), a showreel template for a dense 15-second reel, website capture (screenshots, copy, brand colours and fonts), scripted app recordings with smooth auto-zoom, cursor and keycaps, PDF import, CSV and JSON to charts, a brand kit, posters baked into frame 0, exports for YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reels, TikTok, Shorts and square…

requirements.text: showtime adds no cloud service of its own: no API keys, no accounts, nothing you make is uploaded.
A public PR works without a GitHub login, and values that look like secrets never reach the video (example 29).
It needs no API key unless you choose the mode that runs your own agent.

Limits: the phone check and the look history read the project files and cannot judge whether a video is good; a model reviewer's preference is steadier than its score but is still an opinion; tokens and cost appear only for agents that expose their session log (Claude Code and Codex, as numbers only), and everything else says "not reported by this agent".
